name: Selena Chainani
description: Hi! As president, my role is to oversee our team in various initiatives and events. I lead the team to ensure we’re always supporting the needs and interests of our members!

name: MacKenzie Luong
description: As VP Admin, I help with internal logistics and planning for Ada's Team! In my free time, I play games (Minecraft phase rn) and draw!

name: Kashish Gupta
description: Hi! As VP Academic, I help organize Ada’s Base office hours and tutoring services to support students in their courses. also manage the mentorship program where we connect undergraduates with upper-year students or industry professionals. In my free time, I also love to read books and travel!

name: Ipsa Manhas
description: As VP Communications, I send out monthly newsletters, keep track of the active members on the mailing list, and go over the emails. In my free time, I love journaling, listening to music, and trying out new matcha spots!

name: Arien Alabar
description: As VP Digital Media, I’m currently in charge of the assets of Ada’s Team, making new designs and informing everyone of new Ada’s Team events! In my free time you’ll catch me cafe hopping or doing photography.

name: Aara Likun Vanatia
description: As VP Finance, I look after planning budgets for events, applying for various grants and looking after reimbursements. In my free time you’ll find me watching food vlogs, reading books or hunting down my next food spot.

name: Melrita Cyriac
description: As Industry Outreach, I help out with the coffee&codes as well as serving as a communication link between members and industry folks!

name: Ria Ahir
description: As VP Conference Operations, I help coordinate travel, accommodations, and all the behind the scenes logistics to make attending conferences as smooth as possible! In my free time, I enjoy listening to music and going on long walks.

name: Samia Rahman
description: As VP Conference - Finance, I look after all the budget and grants that go towards conferences! In my free time you’ll find me at some Matcha pop-up or vintage market pop-up!
